comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 4
Consumed Gauge: 120
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 90

It requires three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
No additional effects, it deals only damage. However the damage out-put is way higher than the previous ranks techs of Barrel. The more enemies are targeted the higher the damage will be. Higher Trap increases the damage of this Tech.

I've learned this from "Grave Raider lv60" at the hidden passage of Luxor Lower floor, who uses a throwing knives. Since the Gran Atlas now avialable. However it is less likely they use this Tech.

Hint:
After the fight starts try to provoke them by using a "Power" or "Quick" battle-tech. Two "Grave Raider lv60"(wielding a sword) will most likely counter you with "Power" or "Feint" battle-techs and after that there is a high chance that the "Grave Raider lv60"(who wields throwing knives) will use this Tech against you. It deals high damage, especially when it target your fleet members as well so be careful.
